description: This file implements a Kubernetes controller for custom Foo resources, managing Deployments and updating resource status.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: Kubernetes controller managing Foo resources and associated Deployments.

methods.name: NewController
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new Controller instance with event handlers and informers.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the controller, waits for cache sync, and launches worker goroutines.

methods.name: runWorker
methods.description: Continuously processes items from the workqueue.

methods.name: processNextWorkItem
methods.description: Processes a single work item, handling errors and requeuing if necessary.

methods.name: syncHandler
methods.description: Synchronizes the state of a Foo resource with its Deployment, creating or updating as needed.

methods.name: updateFooStatus
methods.description: Updates the status subresource of a Foo with the current Deployment status.

methods.name: enqueueFoo
methods.description: Enqueues a Foo resource into the workqueue based on its namespace and name.

methods.name: handleObject
methods.description: Handles Deployment objects owned by Foo resources, enqueuing the owning Foo.

methods.name: newDeployment
methods.description: Constructs a new Deployment object for a given Foo resource.
